title: Vacuuming, waking, and a bounded causal explanation
content: Vacuuming makes noise, the noise wakes a child, and waking can make the child unhappy. The explanation is local to the factual context and does not license a blanket prohibition on vacuuming.

variables.name: Vacuuming
variables.content: Whether the vacuum cleaner is running upstairs.

variables.name: Vacuum Noise
variables.content: Whether the vacuuming produces audible noise.

variables.name: Child Awake
variables.content: Whether the child is awakened by the noise.

variables.name: Child Unhappy
variables.content: Whether the awakened child is unhappy.

arrows.because: The vacuum cleaner produces noise while running.
The noise can wake the child.
Being awakened can make the child unhappy.
